verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items are a fair question for a real-time infrastructure platform with server APIs and a CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document any batch or multi-item operation, such as bulk room deletion, bulk participant management, or batch egress. The nearby items cover different capabilities: dispatch rules route callers to rooms, the CLI generates test traffic, and recording starts automatically when a room is created.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
